title: Text artifacts a producer offers to 02-evidence-index-derived (derived-text-manifest.json)
description: A producer that publishes text (for example documents converted to plain text) lists each text artifact here and lists this manifest and every text artifact in its accepted envelope. 02-evidence-index-derived chunks each document into its text_chunks FTS table with provenance: producer job and attempt, artifact path, source path, page (when pages are given) and line range. artifact_path is relative to the producer's attempt; sha256 must equal the envelope's hash of that artifact. pages, when present, maps 1-based page numbers to inclusive line ranges of the text artifact; chunks never cross a page. Documents over the derived index's bounds or not strict UTF-8 are listed with their status and reported as gaps.
